behavior.authority_limit: Syntax-valid owner references are recovery leads, not independent proof of retention, provenance, validity, admission or retry permission.
behavior.empty_or_generic_failure: No invented run ID; no retry, alternate carrier, improver continuation or promotion.
behavior.invalid_envelope: Wrong type, tuple subclass or more than 128 entries: reject without iterating or retaining a supplied prefix; keep previously observed IDs.
behavior.mixed_envelope: Preserve individually valid recovery references from the bounded exact tuple; stop with OWNER_RETAINED_RUN_IDS_INVALID.
behavior.valid_envelope: Exact tuple with at most 128 IDs; validate each using incumbent contracts.v_run_id; prior observed IDs first, then valid owner IDs, with stable deduplication. Preserve the original refusal code.

coverage: Refusal on first and second baseline with original stored EFFECT_UNKNOWN or UNPROVEN cleanup run
Original refusal code, cause and original retained run bytes preserved
Earlier and newly refused IDs, duplicate refs, malformed siblings before and after a valid ref
Wrong-type and tuple-subclass iterators never consumed; oversized tuples not prefix-salvaged
No further execute, improve, select or reflect call after refusal; no mutation of original stored run
All existing aggregate/sequential refinement, factor lock, artifact retention, context and failure cases pass
limits: Synthetic incumbent ArtifactStore and finalizer fixtures; no production Harness2Port
No provider inference, runtime activation, account enrollment, learning efficacy or promotion proof
Other source cohorts in current-primary-context-trial-composition-20261107.json are unchanged and are not recounted here
